articles.title: Super Micro Raided as Taiwan Expands Chip Smuggling Probe
articles.summary: Super Micro Computer Inc.’s offices in Taiwan were raided by government authorities on Monday, widening an investigation into the alleged smuggling of Nvidia Corp. chips into China using the company’s servers, according to a person familiar with the situation.
